name: Marked Safe From
look: A plain white graphic imitating a Facebook Safety Check notice: a blue triangular flag on a thin pole at the top, the words Marked Safe From followed by a blank space, and the word Today underneath.
use: The blank after Marked Safe From names a trivial or silly danger the poster has escaped, parodying the check-in people use to tell friends they are safe after an emergency.
slots: the trivial danger you escaped (in the blank after Marked Safe From)
examples: The meeting that could have been an email
